description: Synthetic labeled B2B email reply dataset for evaluating DeterministicReplyClassifier (app/adapters/reply_classifier.py). All records are fictional; no real people, companies, or captured correspondence.
label_set_note: These are the only reply_state values the DeterministicReplyClassifier.classify() method can actually return. 'positive' and 'not_applicable' exist in the ReplyState type alias but are unreachable from this classifier's code path, so they are excluded from ground-truth labels here.
